parameters.content:
## Ticket log & human review
**Set up once:** select the SAME Sheet + tab in all three Google Sheets nodes. Keep Auto-Map. Select your support channel in both Slack nodes. Publish.
**Follow the numbered ticket path:** validate → check replay → save → notify → confirm. A repeated request returns the existing ticket.
**Separate review lane below:** the background call waits for Slack; the customer receives a reply immediately. A later row records approve/reject for the SAME ticket.
No node transfers money or emails a customer.

## Read the result honestly
Sheet save and Slack delivery are separate outcomes. Never call a failed notification successful.
No automatic retries around writes. Sequential duplicates skip both append and Slack; a new session/day creates a new request.
This workshop uses Sheets replay detection. Real concurrent traffic requires a database unique constraint and delivery retry worker.
